**Calculate Right Vector:** Compute the side vector $\mathbf{s}$ by taking the cross product of the forward vector $\mathbf{f}$ and the input up vector.
**Calculate True Up Vector:** Compute the corrected up vector $\mathbf{u}$ by taking the cross product of the right vector $\mathbf{s}$ and the forward vector $\mathbf{f}$.
